metaDescription: Check that a postpartum or birth doula is ADA-certified before you hire. Search the free ADA registry by name, Doula ID or certificate number.
title: Find an <nb>ADA-certified</nb> doula
lead: Every ADA-certified doula has an official record in the ADA registry. Check a doula’s record before you hire. ADA does not match families with doulas or arrange care.
meta: For families. Free to search, no account needed.

cta.title: Every ADA-certified doula has passed the ADA written and practical exams.

choose.title: Before you choose
choose.photoAlt: A trainee in the ADA Postpartum Doula Program sits holding a newborn training doll
choose.photoCaption: A trainee practises holding a newborn, with a training doll. {date}.
choose.typeValue: A postpartum doula supports the family at home after the birth. A birth doula supports you during labor. Check which credential the doula holds.
choose.languageValue: ADA trains and examines doulas in {languages}. Ask each doula which languages they speak.
choose.insuranceValue: ADA certification is recognized by {insurers}. What is covered depends on your plan. Ask your plan and the doula.
choose.coverageValue: Call member services on the back of your insurance card. Ask whether your plan covers postpartum doula services, mention ADA certification, and ask about pre-authorization and visit limits.
choose.recordValue: Every ADA-certified doula has an official ADA record. Open it before you hire, to confirm the credential is active today.

check.title: Check a doula’s record
check.body: Search the ADA registry by certificate number, Doula ID or full name. The record shows each credential the doula holds and whether it is active today.

more.title: More for families
more.verifyBody: The registry lists every ADA-certified doula. Search by name, Doula ID or certificate number.
more.trainingBody: The ADA Postpartum Doula Program: {modules} modules over {days} days of intensive instruction.
more.concernBody: If something went wrong with an ADA-certified doula, tell ADA. Reports are reviewed under the Code of Conduct.
more.faqBody: Training, exams, certification and what an ADA-certified doula does.

contact.title: Write to ADA
contact.body: Questions about certification, the registry or a doula’s record? Send ADA a message.
contact.smsConsent: Phone is optional. By sharing your mobile number, you agree that Asian Doula Alliance may text you about your inquiry and, if you are a doula in our network, about client matches, work orders and scheduling. Message frequency varies. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of any service. See our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> and <terms>Terms of Service</terms>.
contact.requiredNote: All fields are required unless marked optional.
contact.success: Message sent. ADA will reply by email.
contact.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
contact.network: Could not send your message. Check your connection and try again, or email {email}.
